mapper.select: SELECT si.slot_instance_id AS slotInstanceId, si.service_date AS serviceDate, si.seq AS seq, si.starts_at AS startsAt, si.ends_at AS endsAt, si.capacity AS capacity, si.reserved_count AS reservedCount, CASE WHEN si.ends_at <= DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE si.status END AS status, CAST(CASE WHEN r.reservation_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS reservedByMe FROM erp_bookstore_slot_instance si LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_reservation r ON r.slot_instance_id = si.slot_instance_id AND r.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.status IN ('RESERVED', 'ATTENDED') WHERE si.center_code = #{centerCode} AND si.service_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND si.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY si.service_date ASC, si.seq ASC

SELECT si.slot_instance_id AS slotInstanceId, si.service_date AS serviceDate, si.seq AS seq, si.starts_at AS startsAt, si.ends_at AS endsAt, si.capacity AS capacity, si.reserved_count AS reservedCount, CASE WHEN si.ends_at <= DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE si.status END AS status, CAST(CASE WHEN r.reservation_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS reservedByMe FROM erp_bookstore_slot_instance si LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_reservation r ON r.slot_instance_id = si.slot_instance_id AND r.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.status IN ('RESERVED', 'ATTENDED') WHERE si.center_code = #{centerCode} AND si.seq = #{seq} AND si.service_date IN #{d}

SELECT slot_instance_id AS slotInstanceId, service_date AS serviceDate, seq AS seq, starts_at AS startsAt, ends_at AS endsAt, capacity AS capacity, reserved_count AS reservedCount, status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_slot_instance WHERE slot_instance_id IN #{id}

SELECT slot_instance_id AS slotInstanceId, service_date AS serviceDate, seq AS seq, starts_at AS startsAt, ends_at AS endsAt, capacity AS capacity, reserved_count AS reservedCount, status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_slot_instance WHERE slot_instance_id = #{slotInstanceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_slot_instance SET reserved_count = reserved_count + 1 WHERE slot_instance_id = #{slotInstanceId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND reserved_count < capacity
UPDATE erp_bookstore_slot_instance SET reserved_count = reserved_count - 1 WHERE slot_instance_id = #{slotInstanceId} AND reserved_count > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_reservation (slot_instance_id, student_id, service_date, status, channel) VALUES (#{slotInstanceId}, #{studentId}, #{serviceDate}, 'RESERVED', #{channel})

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_reservation_log (reservation_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by, changed_by_role, reason) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{changedBy}, #{changedByRole}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.slot_instance_id AS slotInstanceId, si.service_date AS serviceDate, si.seq AS seq, si.starts_at AS startsAt, si.ends_at AS endsAt, r.status AS status, r.reserved_at AS reservedAt FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.slot_instance_id AS slotInstanceId, si.service_date AS serviceDate, si.seq AS seq, si.starts_at AS startsAt, si.ends_at AS endsAt, r.status AS status, r.reserved_at AS reservedAt FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.status <> 'CANCELED' AND si.service_date >= #{fromDate} ORDER BY si.service_date ASC, si.seq ASC

SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, st.school AS school, st.grade_key AS gradeKey, st.billing_phone AS contact, si.seq AS seq, si.starts_at AS startsAt, si.ends_at AS endsAt, r.status AS status, r.channel AS channel, r.cancel_reason AS reason, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r2 JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si2 ON si2.slot_instance_id = r2.slot_instance_id WHERE r2.student_id = r.student_id AND r2.status = 'ATTENDED' AND YEAR(si2.service_date) = YEAR(si.service_date) AND MONTH(si2.service_date) = MONTH(si.service_date)) AS monthlyAttendCount FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = r.student_id WHERE si.service_date = #{date} AND si.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY si.seq ASC, st.student_name ASC

SELECT slot_instance_id AS slotInstanceId, service_date AS serviceDate, seq AS seq, starts_at AS startsAt, ends_at AS endsAt, capacity AS capacity, reserved_count AS reservedCount, status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_slot_instance WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND service_date = #{date} ORDER BY seq ASC

SELECT TOP 1 r.reservation_id AS reservationId, si.slot_instance_id AS slotInstanceId, si.service_date AS serviceDate, si.seq AS seq, si.starts_at AS startsAt, si.ends_at AS endsAt, r.status AS status, r.reserved_at AS reservedAt FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND si.service_date = #{serviceDate} AND r.status IN ('RESERVED', 'ATTENDED') ORDER BY r.reservation_id ASC
SELECT r.reservation_id FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id WHERE r.status = 'RESERVED' AND si.ends_at < #{asOf}
